name: Boat repair and marine mechanic

pf.license.need: if: where the state registers boat yards or marine contractors, or requires a license for some work, like an electrician's for shore-power and dock wiring
ask: The yard's or marine contractor's registration number, where the state has one

Each technician's certificates for the work they do: a maker's or industry certificate shown as what the business says, and an electrician's license for shore-power wiring where the state requires one
An EPA certificate for refrigerant work, such as boat air conditioning
pf.license.who: both: the business, and each person
pf.license.check: the state's license lookup; where there's none, a person on Rosie's team checks within 1 business day
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.every_state: refrigerant work only by a person with the EPA certificate for it
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: marine garage liability and coverage for customers' boats in the yard's care, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.otherwise: identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'

pf.services.pattern: drop-off: the boat (on its trailer, or at the yard's dock) is left at the yard and picked up when it's ready

list.name: Diagnosis (won't start, overheats, runs rough, an alarm, electrical)
list.price: one price (the example shop: $129), OK'd in writing on the drop-off page
list.length: a set time, like 1 hour; more time is new work that needs a new yes
list.place: at the shop or the yard

list.name: Repair after a diagnosis
list.price: quoted at the visit: a written estimate with the most it can cost, signed before any repair
list.place: at the shop or the yard
list.after: at the counter, or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text

list.name: Battery test, bilge pump check, zinc anode swap, trailer bearing check, fuel filter change
list.price: one price from the shop's board (the example shop: battery test $35)
list.length: 30 to 60 minutes; wait or drop off

list.name: Engine service (oil, lower unit oil, impeller, plugs, filters)
list.price: one price by engine type and size, from the shop's list

list.name: Winterizing and spring commissioning
list.price: one price by boat and engine size, from the shop's list

list.name: Electrical (batteries, bilge pump, lights, charging)
list.price: one price from the list, or quoted at the visit

list.name: Fiberglass and gelcoat repair
list.price: quoted from photos; the materials are ordered after the deposit (the example: $640, $160 deposit)
list.length: a few days, for the materials and curing

list.name: Haul-out and launch (only where the yard has a lift)
list.place: at the yard's lift and dock, at the booked time

list.name: Sea trial or dock test
list.price: part of the repair; the customer OKs it first
list.place: on the water, in good weather, or at the dock

list.name: Mobile marine repair (at a slip, a marina, a driveway or a storage lot)
list.price: one price, quoted from photos and the engine's details, or quoted at the visit
list.before: a card saved for the trip fee; nothing else taken
list.after: Rosie texts the bill, or the saved card is charged at DONE

list.name: Pre-purchase engine check
list.place: at the shop, or where the boat for sale is

pf.services.capacity: a daily cap on diagnoses (the example shop: 4 a day); one bay or lift slot and one technician per job; the travel lift and the yard's dock are saved like equipment, in the lift's hours; the lift's limits (the example yard: boats up to 30 feet and 10,000 pounds)
pf.services.drop_off_window: drop-off slots by the shop's daily number (the example shop: 4 boats a day), shown as drop-off times with no technician named; a boat arriving by water docks at the yard's dock at the booked time; plus an after-hours key box once the drop-off page is signed
pf.services.living_aboard: the yard's rule, set by the owner: nobody lives aboard while the boat is on stands or in the lift
pf.services.not_offered: hull surveys, towing on the water and rescue: other kinds of work
pf.services.loaners: none: the yard lends no boats
pf.services.warranty: on the receipt: 90 days on labor; parts as the maker covers them
pf.services.nobody_home: a mobile job on a boat at a slip can be done with nobody aboard: dock access and the keys as agreed, and DONE comes with a photo

before_times: What is the boat doing, and since when? In the customer's own words
Any alarms, a fuel smell, or water in the bilge?
Type, length, year, make and model, and the engine make, size and hours
In the water at a slip, or on a trailer or stands? Which marina and slip
Does the engine start? Is there fuel in the tank?
after_time: OK for the technician to run a short dock test or sea trial? Yes or no (on the water only in good weather)
Old parts back? Yes or no
Anything the technician should know, like when the problem happens
secure_page_only: The hull ID and the boat's registration number
The marina's gate or dock code, and the slip
Someone else who may say yes to the estimate, named in writing
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult: the boat's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; a charter or rental boat needs the owner's or the company's yes for any repair

stop_words: a boat sinking, or taking on water faster than the pump clears it
pf.safety.stop_action: 'Get everyone to safety and call 911, or the Coast Guard on channel 16 if on the water' and the generic emergency steps; no booking
dont_run_words: a fuel smell or leak in the engine bay
an engine that overheats, or its alarm sounds
steering or throttle that binds or fails
a bilge pump that runs nonstop or won't run
a battery that is swollen, hot or smoking
a crack or soft spot in the hull
pf.safety.dont_run_action: Rosie says: stay tied up or on the trailer, switch the battery off where it is safe to, and don't start the engine. The booking can go on as a mobile visit or a haul-out.
pf.safety.mobile_stops: a fuel leak, rough water, wind or lightning on the water, or no safe dock access: the technician stops, and the job moves to the yard or another day

pf.first_steps.required: none before the visit; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing on the drop-off page when booking
at_check_in: A recall check on the hull ID and the engine serial number
The walk-around, the engine hours and photos
The fuel level and the battery switch noted
prep_for_reminder: Take out valuables, food and loose gear
For a boat on a trailer: the trailer lights work and the tires are up
Where the boat is, the slip and the dock code, on the secure page
For a mobile job: dock access, shore power if you have it, and the engine hatch clear

pf.visit.check_in: a drop-off: the customer gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the boat or the trailer. A key-box drop-off, or a boat that arrives by water, has no code at the counter: the technician texts IN once the boat and keys are found. Mobile: the code at the boat, as at any door.
pf.visit.intake: the engine hours, the keys, a walk-around with photos, the problem in the customer's words, old parts back or not, the sea trial OK
pf.visit.recall_check: the hull ID and the engine's serial number are checked for open safety recalls at check-in; an open recall is told to the customer, and its fix is free at the maker's dealers
pf.visit.diagnosis: the OK'd fee covers a set time; more time is new work that needs a new yes; no answer is never a yes
pf.visit.estimate: written, with parts and labor lines, new or used, maker or aftermarket parts, and the most it can cost; signed before any repair
pf.visit.added_work: anything over the signed estimate needs a new yes before it's done, logged with the time, the phone and the new total
pf.visit.ready: READY texts the customer the total, the pick-up hours and any storage terms
pf.visit.pick_up: the boat goes only to the customer, or someone they name; the work and any old parts are shown; a launch or a dock test is done together where it applies
pf.visit.done_proof: the drop-off code, or IN, checks the boat in; READY and the pick-up close it
pf.visit.late_drop_off: the yard's rule: diagnosed the same day if there's room, or else the next day
pf.visit.pick_up_and_delivery: not offered: the boat arrives on its trailer or under its own power

pf.money.before: the starting answer is nothing taken; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing, not charged; special-order parts or materials can take a deposit on a price set before the visit
pf.money.after: paid at the counter at pick-up, the shop's own way; or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text, if the owner turns it on
pf.money.mobile: a card saved for the trip fee, kept only for a late cancel or a no-show; the bill after DONE, or the saved card charged at DONE
pf.money.deposit: a parts or materials deposit only on a price set before the visit; deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.storage: a daily storage fee only after the free working days that follow the ready text, told before drop-off, and only once the owner confirms it; storage limits: from the state form
pf.money.after_a_no: after a no to the estimate, only the OK'd diagnosis, plus any putting-back-together the state's rules allow
pf.money.fees: no cancel or no-show fee to start at the shop; the mobile trip fee is the late-cancel and no-show fee
pf.money.cancel: free until the cutoff (the example: 2 days before); a late cancel or a no-show keeps only the trip fee on a mobile visit, and the owner can turn a shop fee on for long jobs
pf.money.tax: the shop's tax rate on parts and labor

never_in_text: The hull ID or the registration number
The marina's gate or dock code
pf.messages.minors: texts about a teen's boat go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each technician's certificates for the work they do, shown as what the business says; an electrician's license for shore-power wiring where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work, in every state
pf.staff.supervision: an apprentice works only while a certified technician who may supervise them is on, where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner or the service writer OKs estimates, added work, sea trials and storage fees
pf.staff.stand_in: only someone certified for that kind of work

pf.rules.written_estimate: switch: a written estimate before work, above an amount: from the state form
pf.rules.written_ok_for_diagnosis: switch: a written OK for the diagnosis fee: from the state form
pf.rules.overage: Rosie's rule: never over the signed estimate without a new yes; no state leeway is used
pf.rules.choose_any_shop: switch: a line saying the customer may pick any shop: from the state form
pf.rules.old_parts: switch: offer the old parts back: from the state form; warranty or core-exchange parts are shown, not given
pf.rules.show_number: switch: the shop's state number on estimates and receipts: from the state form
pf.rules.work_order: switch: what the work order must carry, like the engine hours and the problem in the customer's words: from the state form
pf.rules.storage_notice: switch: storage terms told before drop-off, and the free days: from the state form
pf.rules.unclaimed_vessel: switch: the state's lien and abandoned-vessel steps; the owner runs them, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs
pf.rules.sea_trial: a sea trial or dock test only with the customer's yes on the drop-off page; on the water only in good weather; a no means no trial, and the estimate says so
pf.rules.environmental: switch: how the yard handles waste oil, fuel and bottom paint: from the state form
pf.rules.recalls: the maker's dealers fix open recalls for free; the shop tells the customer and doesn't do the recall work itself

applies: A no-show at drop-off: no fee to start
The boat gets worse before drop-off: the don't-run steps, then a mobile visit or a haul-out
More work found, like rot or corrosion behind a fitting
The boat isn't picked up: storage, then written notice
Weather stops a sea trial or a mobile job
The problem comes back under warranty
pf.edges.handling: each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee

NEW Tue Oct 27 2026 (REDESIGN 2, professions pass P3, batch D2). Built from the refitted auto-repair parent (set "from"); no old flowchart or base plug-in existed, so the plug-in is built from the trade's norm.
Why auto-repair: a boat (on a trailer, or at the yard's dock) is left at a shop or yard with a written estimate OK'd before any repair and picked up when ready, and a mobile technician goes to a slip, a marina, a driveway or a storage lot.
Facts dropoff, extrawork; no switches; settings A set start (a drop-off time), B 2-hour window, cutoff 2 days before (weather, lift schedule, travel). Sent now is OFF: marine repair is booked for a set time or a window (on-water towing and rescue are other kinds of work, not offered). Same sent-now offs and words as rv-repair (S2-30, B7-55, B8-58, S1-21).
Money A (4): visit|none|counter (main: a $129 diagnosis OK'd on the drop-off page, then a signed estimate: $389 boat engine repair + $85 spark plug set, the $129 inside the $389), list|none|counter ($35 battery test), visit|none|bill, list|none|bill. Money B (4): list|card|bill (main: $179 battery replacement at the slip, $89 trip fee as the late-cancel and no-show fee), visit|card|bill (Boat engine repair priced at the visit; quote lines impeller $165 + thermostat $80), list|card|card, photos|deposit|bill ($640 fiberglass repair from photos, $160 deposit for the materials, $480 rest). No A photos path (master S1-13 shows a $20 deposit for it in flow A). No hold, no full price.
Real marine points in the plug-in: stop words are fire or smoke aboard, a boat sinking or taking on water faster than the pump clears it, someone hurt or overboard, a carbon monoxide alarm (911, or the Coast Guard on channel 16 if on the water); don't-run words are a fuel smell or leak, an engine that overheats or alarms, steering or throttle that fails, a bilge pump that runs nonstop or won't run, a bad battery, a hull crack (stay tied up, don't start the engine); a dock test or sea trial only with the customer's yes, on the water only in good weather; mobile stops for a fuel leak, rough water, wind or lightning, or no safe dock access; the lift's size limits; nobody lives aboard on stands or in the lift; hull surveys and on-water towing are not offered; recall check on the hull ID and the engine serial number; a charter or rental boat needs the owner's or company's yes for any repair; a 90-day labor warranty.
The main B example is a battery replacement, not a bilge pump, so the booking example is not one of the don't-run words. The A story is an outboard that stalls at idle (not overheating, which is a don't-run word).
Kinds of work in sign-up: mobile marine repair + boat wiring (a wiring license where the state asks, for shore-power work) for Lee Mobile Marine, and the marine shop as the second company. Names under 20 characters. License numbers are EX-xxxx style. B4-34's screen is set for a slip (marina lot, no pets aboard). Extra rename pairs as in motorcycle, plus Leak repair -> Boat engine repair and At my home -> At my slip.
Own steps: A8-x01/x02 recall check, A8-x03 to x05 the diagnosis inside the OK'd hour, A8-x09 a late part (a boat in the water waits at the yard's dock).
Self-checks: (1) as for rv-repair; (2) the example messages avoid the stop words and the don't-run words as everyday booking examples; (3) B3-11 and B3-18 are one conversation (engine won't start, fuel smell asked, steps).
Keep: flush, leak, valve, drips, Trip fee, Towing, Battery test, Oil change (master text and the lower unit oil change).
